name: dsfd_capt_cd

job.purpose: S81 capture cluster dsfd_sp_capture_c: the fld DONE word {toggle, fault, phase} (16 serial-clock flops, text of ctrl_c/dsfd_sp_capture_c.sv) as a hardened leaf. It was flat cluster logic; the cluster is now wires + closed children with one clock entry per child (the first cluster's single-pin spine measured 1,222 ps insertion / 226 ps spread). Outline and layers of the 15.12-um die relay class (M5 cap, M5 PG pitch 2.7).

benches.name: capc_lockstep_exact
benches.cmd: bash tools/s81_ph/capc_bench.sh {RUN}/bench t1 'mix mix11 mix12 mix13 trace err over range rreq'

floorplan_why: 16 flops + the 2-flop reset synchroniser: the 15.12 x 15.12 die relay outline class (the smallest closed class; M5 PG pitch 2.7). Status in on W (from the capture tile left of the control tile), DONE word out on N (to the dsfd_rly_15_SN stage toward the cluster's N face), serial clock and reset on E.
